messages:
maria: quick alert - found a small batch of prod DB backups in archive with no SSE-KMS headers. spotted during daily archive-sanity check.

satish: how many? which tenants?

maria: ~120 objects across 3 tenants (tenant-17, tenant-42, tenant-99). all from last night rotation window. metadata missing `x-amz-server-side-encryption` / `x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id`. sizes look normal.

eva: can you paste one example metadata snippet?

maria: 
```
Key: backups/tenant-42/2026-03-20/backup-2026-03-20T03-12-07.tar.gz
Content-Length: 2.4GB
x-amz-meta-origin: db-cluster-primary
x-amz-server-side-encryption:
x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id:
```

sam: hmm. rotator should either preserve SSE headers or re-encrypt on write. any recent rotator deploys or config flips?

satish: i did a RBAC cleanup last week and removed some legacy grants. rotator uses `blob-rotator-sa` which I thought retained kms:Encrypt. i'll check IAM change log.

infra-bot: deploy:blob-rotation v2.3.1 rolled 2026-03-19 02:45 UTC (sha: c4d2f6) by ci/cd

maria: timeline = v2.3.1 + RBAC cleanup overlap. either binary changed behavior or grant missing.

eva: check CloudTrail for PutObject and KMS events in the rotation time window. specifically search for PutObject requests to backups/* without SSE headers.

maria: CloudTrail snippet: PutObject shows 120 successful puts. KMS Encrypt events = 0 for those request IDs.

sam: then client didn't request SSE-KMS on upload rather than KMS rejecting. any config toggles? i recall MR #1127 added `preserve-sse=false` to avoid double-encrypt when copying between stores.

satish: yup that MR set preserve-sse=false. assumption was a downstream step would add SSE headers. appears that step didn't run for these tenants.

eva: this is a code+process gap. severity: high because backups are unencrypted at rest. immediate mitigation steps: pause rotator, isolate affected objects into quarantine prefix, re-copy from snapshot-store (which has originals) and write with SSE-KMS, audit and alert on PutObject without SSE for backup prefixes, short-lived KMS grant if needed.

sam: action items: revert rotator config to preserve SSE, add unit/integration test for cross-region copy preserving headers, add a canary that copies a test blob and asserts SSE metadata, and update deploy checklist.

satish: i'll re-grant a time-limited kms:Encrypt to blob-rotator-sa (ttl=1h) and run a scoped re-encrypt job for the 120 objects using GenerateDataKey + PutObject with `x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms`. will capture requestIDs for audit.

maria: eva -> add SIEM rule: alert on PutObject to backups/* where `x-amz-server-side-encryption` is empty. also raise CloudTrail logging level for object operations for a week and ensure retention.

eva: noted. i'll also update RBAC cleanup playbook to include a metadata-forwarding checklist and a KMS grant verification step.

oncall: prepping customer comms template. likely internal P1 for encops; customers only if their compliance requires immediate disclosure.

sam: vuln triage: process vulnerability, no known exploit. mark as internal severity, CVE N/A. require postmortem and gating of rotator rollout on tests + alerts.

maria: opening incident ticket and postmortem. tagging infra-bot to create ENCOPS ticket.

infra-bot: created ticket ENCOPS-207654: "rotator metadata-preserve bug -> unencrypted backups" assigned satish, sam, eva. due: 2026-03-22

maria: i'll keep rotator paused until re-encrypt job and SIEM alert are in place. thanks all. :thumbsup:
